final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT major.college AS college, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY major.college), totals AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts), paired AS (SELECT college, group_count, 1.0 * group_count / total_count AS share FROM college_counts CROSS JOIN totals WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(group_count) AS average_count FROM paired) SELECT college, group_count, share, group_count - average_count FROM paired CROSS JOIN averages WHERE average_count IS NOT NULL AND group_count > average_count
